# Luxury HB Home

> A licensed 4-bedroom Huntington Beach vacation rental that sleeps 7. It has a Brunswick Gold Crown pool table, a BBQ island, and a spa-style primary suite. The beach is about 8 minutes away. Book only on Airbnb.

Luxury HB Home is an entire house in Huntington Beach, California 92649 (permit STR-2025-0006). It is rated 5.0 from 10 Airbnb reviews and is an Airbnb Guest Favorite hosted by a Superhost. It is a fit for groups of up to 7, families, festival weekends, and travel nurses or remote workers who want a real kitchen and a workspace.

## At a glance
- Sleeps: 7
- Layout: 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms
- Pool table: Brunswick Gold Crown, plus an electronic dartboard
- Outdoor: BBQ island under a pergola, lounge seating, grassy yard
- Primary suite: soaking tub and rain shower
- Work: dedicated workspace and fast Wi-Fi
- Laundry: in-unit washer and dryer
- Parking: free on-site parking and a Tesla Level 2 charger
- Climate: air conditioning
- Kitchen: quartz counters, stainless appliances, dining for the group
- Utilities: included
- Stays: up to 30 nights; weekly stays get 9% off on Airbnb
- Check-in / checkout: 4:00 p.m. / 11:00 a.m.
- Booking: only through Airbnb. No off-platform payment.
